unit: molecule cluster with selected original indication(s); NOT comprehensive drug-indication pairs
endpoint: FDA approval in selected indication(s), inherited frozen adjudications
estimand: Finite-horizon cumulative approval after clinical entry, NOT eventual or preclinical PoS
status_rule: Unknown is retained, not deleted. Failed remains nonapproval through cutoff. No censoring at discontinuation.
scope: 45 bounded candidate checks: 15 discovery identities and 30 vendor-only status assignments. Existing approvals and all other historical classifications are inherited, not independently re-audited.
all_drugs_tier: Not built. This purposive rare panel cannot supply an all-drugs estimate.
pair_design: Future primary unit: molecule-indication pair, own entry/outcome dates, approvals only for that indication; flag prior human data and prior molecule approval at pair entry. Cluster uncertainty by molecule; equal-molecule-weight sensitivity. No automatic new samples for age cohorts, trials or territories.

limitations: Not a probability sample or complete census; discovery remains concentrated in genetic CNS programmes.
Clinical-entry clock may begin in healthy volunteers before disease-specific patient exposure. Pair-level clocks require separate adjudication.
Historical label consistency and inherited approval/entry ascertainment remain limitations.
Recent entrants have immature follow-up; 10/12-year curves disproportionately depend on older entrants and an exchangeability assumption.
Active includes retained programmes and safety follow-up; it does not universally mean advancing toward approval.
Failure counts include sponsor/portfolio exits, not only biological failures.
Finite-horizon invariance to status labels is intentional: administrative censoring depends on dates/approvals, not active/failed classification.
No valid independent weighted blend of nested layers; their samples overlap.
No efficacy or eventual approval rate can be estimated reliably from the four closest peers alone.
